verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes an interactive API reference or runnable in-docs examples for Stripe Terminal. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a published OpenAPI specification repository (a developer building block), API versioning docs, and a CLI for testing. These are not an explorable reference with runnable examples, and the docs-path OpenAPI probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
